title: TransactionRequest
description: Request body of POST /v1/transactions (SDS §19.2, FR-M.2), reused transaction-by-transaction inside POST /v1/batches (FR-M.8) and as the base of POST /v1/issuances (FR-AE.2). Field names mirror canonical/openapi.yaml's RecordDocumentRequest/Party/Line/Totals one-for-one (canonical calls the parties object "parties"; this public resource calls it "counterparty", SDS §19.2's own term) so the two sides of the ingestion-svc -> canonical-svc sync edge never drift. entityRef is checked against the caller's token scope (API-24) rather than carried as a separate tenantId, since tenant and entity scope come from the token on the public surface.

sourceKey.description: Part of the idempotency pair (API-13, API-15, FR-M.3).

sourceRevision.description: Part of the idempotency pair (API-15, FR-M.3). Lower than already recorded is ING-002.

documentFunction.description: The caller's assertion of the document's function; rules reclassify it (INV-REQ-371 behavior 5), so the canonical value is the classification result, not this assertion. ADJUSTMENT is treated as a credit note for the conditions of INV-REQ-561, INV-REQ-558 and INV-REQ-693. Mapping into the function vocabulary of rules-svc: INVOICE and BILL_FOR_PAYMENT map to BILL_FOR_PAYMENT; CREDIT_NOTE, DEBIT_NOTE and ADJUSTMENT map to ADJUSTMENT; NOT_A_BILL maps to NOT_A_BILL (INV-Q-6507).

documentNumber.description: Required when documentFunction is BILL_FOR_PAYMENT (ING-009); for every other documentFunction it carries the number issued to the customer (IBT-001, INV-REQ-714) when the source system holds it, and the source system's internal reference is never sent as the number; ingestion-svc forwards it unchanged as the canonical documentNumber (INV-T-6274).

postingTimestamp.description: Time the source system posted the document: the field a scheduled pull uses as its watermark (INV-REQ-790). Optional in the schema; a pull that finds it absent is refused by the operation, not by this schema. The offset is optional: a value without an offset is read in the source connection's declared zone, default Asia/Singapore, and canonical-svc records the assumption in the decision trace (INV-REQ-77, INV-Q-6951). The pattern checks the shape only: a calendar-impossible date such as 30 February passes the pattern and is refused by the operation with 400 and SRT-001.

direction.description: Absent means SALE (INV-REQ-809). A purchase line without inputTaxClaimed is refused with ING-007; the condition is enforced by the receiving service, not by this schema.

networkReceipt.description: Network receipt of a purchase received over the network (INV-REQ-428). A buyerDisposition outside PENDING, ACCEPTED, REJECTED is refused with 400 and SRT-001. A request that carries networkReceipt together with networkIssuance, or with direction SALE or no direction, is refused with 400 and SRT-001 (INV-Q-6999). Without supplierDocUuid the receipt is correlated by the fallback key of INV-REQ-429.

networkIssuance.description: Network issuance of an issued document (INV-REQ-327). When issuedDocUuid is present canonical-svc binds it as the Doc UUID instead of generating one; a collision with a different commercial document is ING-011. A request that carries networkIssuance together with networkReceipt, or with direction PURCHASE, is refused with 400 and SRT-001 (INV-Q-6999).

precedingDocumentNumber.description: Preceding Invoice Number (IBT-025): the number of the invoice a credit note corrects, where the original is known (INV-REQ-560). Optional; a number without precedingDocumentDate is valid, canonical-svc looks the original up or raises RUL-008 (INV-REQ-701). On a credit note, or a document sent as ADJUSTMENT (treated as a credit note, INV-REQ-371 behavior 7), with neither preceding field, precedingBlankJustification and evidenceRef are required (ING-019).

precedingDocumentDate.description: Preceding Invoice Date (IBT-026): the date of the invoice a credit note corrects, where the original is known (INV-REQ-560). The credit note resolves its rate and category code from this date (INV-REQ-701). On a credit note, or a document sent as ADJUSTMENT (treated as a credit note, INV-REQ-371 behavior 7), with neither preceding field, precedingBlankJustification and evidenceRef are required (ING-019).

precedingBlankJustification.description: Why a credit note leaves precedingDocumentNumber and precedingDocumentDate blank, e.g. a volume rebate not attributable to one invoice; notes that a rate-change straddle was considered (INV-REQ-561, INV-REQ-702). Required, together with evidenceRef, when documentFunction is CREDIT_NOTE or ADJUSTMENT (an ADJUSTMENT is treated as a credit note, INV-REQ-371 behavior 7) and neither precedingDocumentNumber nor precedingDocumentDate is present; otherwise optional; refused with ING-019 (INV-REQ-561, INV-Q-1677, INV-Q-3450, INV-Q-3488). The condition is enforced by the receiving service, not by this schema (as documentNumber states ING-009).

evidenceRef.description: Reference to the business's other documentary evidence that GST was accounted for on the original supplies, for a blank-linked credit note (INV-REQ-561). Required, together with precedingBlankJustification, when documentFunction is CREDIT_NOTE or ADJUSTMENT (an ADJUSTMENT is treated as a credit note, INV-REQ-371 behavior 7) and neither precedingDocumentNumber nor precedingDocumentDate is present; otherwise optional; refused with ING-019 (INV-REQ-561, INV-Q-1677, INV-Q-3450, INV-Q-3488). The condition is enforced by the receiving service, not by this schema (as documentNumber states ING-009).

documentKind.description: The upstream system's own name for the document, the middle key of the classification table (INV-REQ-658). Free text with no value set; retained for audit and never used for any other decision (INV-REQ-800 b3). A request without it is refused with 400 and SRT-001 by ingestion-svc (the io_contract marks it required; a property is never made required within a major version) (INV-Q-6496).

replacesReceiptNumber.description: The receipt number of the simplified tax invoice that this full invoice replaces (INV-REQ-440). Optional; aggregation-svc excludes the receipt by this number, or the full invoice is flagged ING-014 if the receipt's aggregate was already transmitted.

notes.description: Free-text note of the source document (INV-REQ-805).

attachmentRefs.description: Pointers to supporting documents such as bills of lading, never content: neither transmitted nor embedded (INV-REQ-649).

nettedCreditNoteKeys.description: The sourceKey values of the credit notes, posted by the same entityRef and sourceSystem, that this revised invoice nets. Allowed only when documentFunction is INVOICE (CREDIT_NOTE, DEBIT_NOTE, BILL_FOR_PAYMENT, ADJUSTMENT and NOT_A_BILL are refused; an ADJUSTMENT is treated as a credit note, INV-REQ-371 behavior 7); any other combination is a contract violation, refused with 400 and SRT-001. The System never infers a netting: the ERP declares it. It has an effect only while the original has not been transmitted (INV-Q-6614, INV-REQ-558).

gstNotAdjusted.description: The caller's declaration that supplier and customer agreed not to adjust the GST charged on the original invoice and the conditions for doing so are met. Allowed only when documentFunction is CREDIT_NOTE or ADJUSTMENT (an ADJUSTMENT is treated as a credit note, INV-REQ-371 behavior 7); any other combination is a contract violation, refused with 400 and SRT-001. Absent means false. The System does not verify the conditions and never infers the marker (INV-REQ-693, INV-Q-6639).

sourceDocumentRef.description: Reference to the source document in the tenant's document store (INV-REQ-1319). Required for Types 2 and 3 once the entity is live; the condition is enforced by the receiving service, not by this schema.

buyerInvoiceRefs.description: The references (numbers) the customer gave the self-billing invoices that this document derives from (INV-REQ-696). Required for a SALE document of an entity that the Scope pack's self-billing assignment puts on the Type 2 side, a condition canonical-svc enforces by refusing the record request with 400 and SRT-001, not this schema; otherwise optional. Never transmitted to the network: it is retained as evidence (BUYER_INVOICE_REFERENCE) (INV-Q-7045).

party.description: A party carrying only partyRef is resolved by masterdata-svc; an unresolved one holds the document at 202 with MDM-001 (INV-REQ-808). providedBy MIGRATED is refused with 400 and SRT-001, since MIGRATED is set only by an import. identifierScheme and identifierValue are enforced by the receiving service where no partyRef is given.

approvedSchemes.description: The counterparty's approved scheme status items (INV-REQ-2445, INV-REQ-2433), effective-dated; canonical-svc passes them to masterdata-svc, which stores them with provenance. Never inferred from the document.

arcsGstChargeAgreed.description: Whether the counterparty agreed to the GST charge under the Approved Refund Collection Scheme (INV-REQ-2446).

unitPrice.description: Money as a decimal string, up to 6 places (API-12).

lineAmount.description: Money as a decimal string, decimal(19,2) (API-12).

taxAmount.description: Money as a decimal string, decimal(19,2) (API-12).

inputTaxClaimed.description: Input tax the business intends to claim, decimal(19,2) (INV-REQ-809). A purchase line without it raises ING-007; the condition is enforced by the receiving service, not by this schema.

sgdTotalExcludingTax.description: Total excluding tax in SGD. Stated by the caller in SGD; the System validates it and never recomputes it (FR-M.7). Required together with the other SGD totals and exchangeRate when the transaction currency is not SGD (INV-REQ-466, INV-NOTE-3 section 19.5). Money as a decimal string (API-12).

sgdTotalTax.description: Total tax (GST) in SGD. Stated by the caller in SGD; the System validates it and never recomputes it (FR-M.7). Required together with the other SGD totals and exchangeRate when the transaction currency is not SGD (INV-REQ-466, INV-NOTE-3 section 19.5). Money as a decimal string (API-12).

sgdTotalIncludingTax.description: Total including tax in SGD. Stated by the caller in SGD; the System validates it and never recomputes it (FR-M.7). Required together with the other SGD totals and exchangeRate when the transaction currency is not SGD (INV-REQ-466, INV-NOTE-3 section 19.5). Money as a decimal string (API-12).

exchangeRate.description: Exchange rate applied to convert to SGD, decimal(19,8) (INV-NOTE-3 section 20.2). Required together with the three SGD totals when the transaction currency is not SGD (INV-REQ-466, INV-NOTE-3 section 19.5). Decimal string (API-12).

exchangeRateSource.description: Source of the exchange rate, recorded with the rate for audit (INV-REQ-467).
